tasks.name: Implement and optimize networking features and connectivity.

concepts.name: Amazon VPC
concepts.description: Provides logically isolated networks, subnets, routing, and connectivity for AWS resources.

concepts.name: VPC subnets
concepts.description: Segment VPC address space and associate resources with Availability Zones and routing.

concepts.name: VPC route tables
concepts.description: Control where subnet or gateway traffic is directed.

concepts.name: Security groups
concepts.description: Stateful virtual firewalls applied to ENIs/resources.

concepts.name: Network ACLs
concepts.description: Stateless subnet-level traffic filters with ordered allow and deny rules.

concepts.name: NAT gateways
concepts.description: Provide outbound IPv4 translation for resources such as instances in private subnets.

concepts.name: Egress-only internet gateway
concepts.description: Provides outbound-only IPv6 internet connectivity for VPC resources.

concepts.name: VPC endpoints and AWS PrivateLink
concepts.description: Provide private connectivity to supported services without requiring public internet paths.

concepts.name: VPC peering
concepts.description: Provides private point-to-point routing between two VPCs with non-overlapping address space.

concepts.name: AWS Transit Gateway
concepts.description: Acts as a hub for connecting multiple VPCs and on-premises networks.

concepts.name: AWS network protection services
concepts.description: Includes controls such as DNS Firewall, AWS WAF, Shield, and Network Firewall.

concepts.name: Network architecture cost optimization
concepts.description: Reduces avoidable data processing, cross-AZ, NAT, or transfer charges through appropriate architecture.

concepts.name: Amazon Route 53
concepts.description: Provides authoritative DNS, domain routing policies, health checks, and DNS-related features.

concepts.name: Route 53 Resolver
concepts.description: Provides DNS resolution in VPCs plus inbound/outbound endpoints and forwarding rules for hybrid DNS.

concepts.name: Route 53 routing policies
concepts.description: Determine how Route 53 answers DNS queries, such as simple, weighted, latency, failover, geolocation, geoproximity, and multivalue.

concepts.name: Route 53 Resolver query logging
concepts.description: Logs DNS queries made through Route 53 Resolver for selected VPCs.

concepts.name: Amazon CloudFront
concepts.description: Content delivery network that caches and serves content through edge locations.

concepts.name: CloudFront caching and cache keys
concepts.description: Controls what request values form cache keys and how cached objects are reused and refreshed.

concepts.name: AWS Global Accelerator
concepts.description: Uses the AWS global network and anycast static IP addresses to route users to optimal healthy regional endpoints.

concepts.name: VPC Flow Logs
concepts.description: Capture metadata about IP traffic to and from VPC network interfaces, subnets, or VPCs.

concepts.name: Elastic Load Balancing access logs
concepts.description: Record requests sent to a load balancer for traffic analysis and troubleshooting.

concepts.name: AWS WAF logs
concepts.description: Record web requests evaluated by a web ACL and the rule action applied.

concepts.name: CloudFront logs
concepts.description: Record viewer requests to a CloudFront distribution.

concepts.name: VPC Reachability Analyzer
concepts.description: Statically analyzes the network configuration path between a source and destination.

concepts.name: Hybrid network connectivity
concepts.description: Connects on-premises networks with AWS using services such as Direct Connect and Site-to-Site VPN.

concepts.name: AWS Direct Connect
concepts.description: Provides dedicated network connectivity between customer networks and AWS.

concepts.name: AWS Site-to-Site VPN
concepts.description: Provides encrypted IPsec connectivity between a customer network and AWS.

concepts.name: CloudWatch Network Flow Monitor
concepts.description: Provides near real-time visibility into network performance for supported compute/resource flows.

concepts.name: CloudWatch Internet Monitor
concepts.description: Observes how internet performance and availability affect application end users.

concepts.name: CloudWatch Network Synthetic Monitor
concepts.description: Uses probes between AWS subnets and destination IPs to measure hybrid network latency and packet loss.

concepts.name: AWS CloudTrail
concepts.description: Records AWS API activity for auditing and operational history.

questions.prompt: Order a practical network troubleshooting workflow.

items.label: Define the exact failing source, destination, protocol, port, and time
Trace the intended route and connectivity components
Check security groups, NACLs, firewalls, and service-specific controls
Correlate flow/access/firewall logs and monitoring data
Apply the smallest confirmed configuration fix
Retest the path and monitor the result

questions.explanation: Network troubleshooting is most efficient when the failing flow is precisely scoped, the path and controls are inspected, evidence is correlated, and only then is a targeted fix applied and verified.
